title: Fuels: Coal, Petroleum and Beyond
summary: Where fossil fuels come from, how crude oil is refined, what makes a good fuel, and the move towards cleaner energy.

ib.note: Extension: strong Criterion D (impacts of science) opportunity

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Class 8 Ch 5: Coal and Petroleum; Ch 6: Combustion and Flame (fuel efficiency)
Ch 4: Carbon and its Compounds (combustion, hydrocarbons as fuels)

objectives: I can explain how coal, petroleum and natural gas formed and why they are non-renewable.
I can describe how crude oil is separated by fractional distillation and name the main fractions.
I can compare fuels using calorific value and the characteristics of a good fuel.
I can evaluate the environmental effects of burning fossil fuels.
misconceptions: Fossil fuels are made from dinosaur bones.
Petrol is dug out of the ground ready to use.
The fuel with the most energy is always the best fuel.
